en.html:
The plan was disgracefully rough.

—Infiltrate as far as possible. Thereafter, assault.

Finished.

An operation? Two verbs cannot carry that much dignity. But the operatives were Ichijou and myself, not assassination specialists, and the deadline was both uncertain and very near. Under those conditions, where was a proper plan to come from?

Uncertain and near meant: before the Oyumi shogunate army finished preparing to attack Prince Maidono. For two warriors to attack an army already on the move and kill its commander—think it through, impossible. Without thinking, also impossible.

While Raichou Imagawa remained at Oyumi's Kubo headquarters: that was our only opportunity.

...No. Even then, could we? A proper military installation, now packed with a great army. How difficult would an assault become?

Still, a sudden mobilization must have thrown headquarters into considerable confusion. Confusion should leave an opening.

—There, and nowhere else, was something to stake our hope on.

計画は酷く杜撰である。
　
　――潜入できるところまで潜入し、<ruby>然<rt>しか</rt></ruby>るのち強襲。
以上。

　作戦と呼ぶようなものではない。
　が、実行者が暗殺の専門家に<ruby>非<rt>あら</rt></ruby>ざる俺と一条、時間
制限が詳細不明ながら至近、という条件ではまともな
作戦などそもそも立てようもなかった。

　時間制限が不明にして至近とはつまり、小弓幕軍が
舞殿宮攻撃の準備を終える前に……という意味である。
　作戦行動中の軍隊を二騎で襲撃して主将を討ち取る
のはどう考えても、いや考えなくても無理だからだ。

　今川雷蝶が小弓の公方府に留まっている間しか<ruby>機会<rt>チャンス</rt></ruby>
は無い。……否。それでもどうか、と思う。
　公方府は歴とした軍事施設であり、しかも今は大軍
が詰める。襲撃の困難は如何程になろう。

　だが急な軍の召集は公方府に少なからぬ混乱を生じ
させている筈。ならば隙もあるに違いない。
　
　――そこが唯一、望みを懸けられる点だった。

en.html: The odds were poor. Perhaps worse than at Fudaraku, where our operation had failed so magnificently as an operation. Yet, strangely, I felt no urgency. This unlikely plan would succeed; some almost prophetic sense assured me...◆not that I possessed any such thing. That kind of mental anesthetic, unfortunately, I did not have. I knew how little chance we had. Even so, desperate anxiety would not stir. Naturally, thinking what failure would mean for Ichijou, the prince and his people, and myself brought both fear and urgency. But the failure to assassinate Raichou Imagawa, in itself, caused me none. Rather—if that was how it ended, perhaps better so...
en.text:
The odds were poor. Perhaps worse than at Fudaraku, where our operation had failed so magnificently as an operation.

Yet, strangely, I felt no urgency. This unlikely plan would succeed; some almost prophetic sense assured me...◆not that I possessed any such thing. That kind of mental anesthetic, unfortunately, I did not have.

I knew how little chance we had. Even so, desperate anxiety would not stir. Naturally, thinking what failure would mean for Ichijou, the prince and his people, and myself brought both fear and urgency.

But the failure to assassinate Raichou Imagawa, in itself, caused me none.

Rather—if that was how it ended, perhaps better so...

en.html:
Kageaki"..."
Ichijou"..."
Kageaki"Have you considered how this arrangement looks to the other passengers?"
Ichijou"I'd say somebody found a useful windbreak."
Kageaki"The sea is cold. I would rather not test it. Please leave enough room for me to move."
Ichijou"Good thing I'm not watching from outside, then."
Kageaki"That is the difficulty. One coat, two people. We cannot both have all the space."
Ichijou"Broad daylight. On a boat. Where are you planning to move?"
Kageaki"Nowhere. But being able to move nowhere is different from being unable to move anywhere."
Ichijou"Can't you simply do nothing? Must doing nothing also have a plan?"
Kageaki"For me, yes."
Ichijou"Why are you admitting that so confidently?"
Kageaki"On this weakness, at least, my knowledge of myself is complete."
Ichijou"...Yes. Complete, all right."

en.html:
—That victory was precisely what troubled me.

I could not tell her.

The girl was beautiful. A person with an innocent belief, who had given body and soul to it, could shine so brightly.

Dazzling. Precious.

Even now, I felt no differently.

She was the very ideal I had let go.

Then why—why could I not lose myself in that light?

Why did I stop short?

In present-day Yamato, the holders of armed force did as they pleased, oppressing and exploiting the weak. This girl alone stood with the weak, wielding force against the arrogant strong.

Recognize justice there. Submit to it. Become part of it.

...One step before that, why did I stop?

Why did it trouble me so? What lay beyond the light she gave off...

Obscured by that brilliance, something remained.

Hidden in shadow, its nature unknown. Why could I not leave it alone?

Why————

――その<ruby>勝利<rt>・・</rt></ruby>にこそ俺の不安があるのだ。
　とは、口にできなかった。

　少女は美しい。
　無垢の信念を有し、そのために身魂を捧げた人間と
いうものは、こうまでも輝く。

　眩しいと感ずる。
　尊いと思う。
　
　やはり、その思いは今でも変わらない。

　この少女は俺が手放してしまった<ruby>理想<rt>ゆめ</rt></ruby>そのものだ。

　だというのに、何故――
　俺はこの光輝の中に埋没できないのだろう。

　何故、踏み<ruby>止<rt>とど</rt></ruby>まってしまうのか。

　<ruby>武力<rt>ちから</rt></ruby>ある者達が悉く<ruby>欲儘<rt>ほしいまま</rt></ruby>に振舞い、弱者を虐げ搾取
するこの現代大和で、唯一、弱者の側に立って武力を
揮い不遜な強者に挑もうとする少女――
　そこに正義を認め。服し。一部となる、

　……その一歩手前で。
　どうして俺は踏み止まってしまうのか。

　何故、こんなにも気に掛かるのだろう。

　この輝きに<ruby>眩<rt>くら</rt></ruby>まされてしまっている<ruby>何か<rt>・・</rt></ruby>。
　陰に隠れ、正体の知れないそれが、どうしてこうも
引っ掛かるのか。

　どうして――――

en.html:
According to a local police officer in touch with the chief, Oyumi's military district was effectively under martial law, preparing for full-scale war. The main roads had already been closed, he reported.

Naturally, dragoon patrols were flying through the sky. Only the sea left unguarded? That would make no sense. Raichou Imagawa had probably imposed the alert to guard against a first strike.

...There are limits even to overreaction. But I could say that only because I knew the prince's actual position. For the Oyumi Kubo, surely it was a natural precaution.

Naturally, dragoon patrols were flying through the sky. Only the sea left unguarded? That would make no sense. Raichou Imagawa had probably imposed the alert to guard against a first strike.

...There are limits even to overreaction. But I could say that only because I knew the prince's actual position. For the Oyumi Kubo, surely it was a natural precaution.

ja.html:
署長と繋がっている現地の警察官からの連絡によれ
ば、小弓軍管区は本格的な戦争に備えた事実上の戒厳
状態にあるという。
　主要な道路は既に封鎖されている、との事だ。

　空は無論<ruby>竜騎兵<rt>ドラグーン</rt></ruby>の警邏隊が飛び回っている。これで
海路だけノーマークなどという事は有り得ない。
　今川雷蝶は先制攻撃を受ける危険性に配慮して警戒
態勢を敷いたのだろう。

　……過剰反応にも程があるが。それは親王側の実情
を知る人間だからこそ云える事だ。
　小弓公方にしてみれば、当然の措置に違いない。

en.html:
Kageaki"Nearly all Bousou falls under the Oyumi army. Better to regard every port as unusable. We disembark at Urayasu."
Kageaki"From there, a bus to Funabashi. Then on foot. A little slower, but least conspicuous, and easier to change our course."
Ichijou"Armor up and fly there—if only we could, so simple."
Kageaki"The moment we enter Oyumi airspace, we will be detected. By headquarters, we will be completely surrounded."
en.text:
Kageaki"Nearly all Bousou falls under the Oyumi army. Better to regard every port as unusable. We disembark at Urayasu."

Kageaki"From there, a bus to Funabashi. Then on foot. A little slower, but least conspicuous, and easier to change our course."

Ichijou"Armor up and fly there—if only we could, so simple."

Kageaki"The moment we enter Oyumi airspace, we will be detected. By headquarters, we will be completely surrounded."

景明 「房総半島はほぼ全域が小弓軍の管轄にある。 港は全て使えないとみた方がいい。 　船は浦安で降りる」
景明 「そこから船橋までは乗合自動車バス。その先は 徒歩だ。 　少しばかり時間は掛かるが、それが一番目 立たないし小回りも利く」
一条 「装甲して飛んでいければ楽なんですけど」
景明 「小弓領空へ入った途端に察知される。 　公方府へ着く頃には完全包囲下だ」
ja.text:
景明
「房総半島はほぼ全域が小弓軍の管轄にある。
港は全て使えないとみた方がいい。
　船は浦安で降りる」
景明
「そこから船橋までは乗合自動車バス。その先は
徒歩だ。
　少しばかり時間は掛かるが、それが一番目
立たないし小回りも利く」
一条
「装甲して飛んでいければ楽なんですけど」
景明
「小弓領空へ入った途端に察知される。
　公方府へ着く頃には完全包囲下だ」

en.html: Or rather, we would never reach it.
en.text: Or rather, we would never reach it.

ja.html: というより、着けるわけがなかった。
ja.text: というより、着けるわけがなかった。

en.html:
...Though that one might scatter them anyway.

I thought of our other reason for going to Oyumi.

“Silver Star is Rokuhara's”—Aoe's final words had not left me. At Fudaraku Castle we had learned nothing. The Kubo headquarters must be our next place to investigate.

Oyumi first...

ja.html:
……<ruby>あいつ<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>ならばそれでも、蹴散らしてしまうかも
しれないが。
　
　小弓へゆく目的の、もう一つを思う。

　白銀の星は六波羅の――青江が遺したその一言を俺
は忘れていない。
　普陀楽城では何の情報も得られなかった。ならば、
次にあたるべきは公方府だ。
　まずは、小弓……
